text: Pasted the assignment brief (agentic development; genAI-in-CS-courses policy dashboard; validation, timeline, token pages) and asked to finish it as quickly as possible.

Found the working folder sat inside an unrelated parent git repo. Created an isolated repo for the project instead. Stated it would keep data real and cited, leave the evaluation/reflection to the student, and confirm before publishing.

Web search + fetch of course policy pages. Search summaries were thin, so switched to fetching primary course pages. Several fetches failed (Cornell/UChicago certificate errors, Princeton behind SSO, 61A 404); those courses were excluded rather than coded from secondary summaries.
Coded 17 policies (16 courses at 8 universities + 1 community-college division) on a 0-4 permissiveness scale. Georgia Tech syllabi were PDFs; extracted text locally with pypdf to verify quotes.
Wrote analysis/analyze.py, tests (data integrity, analysis fixtures, site/data consistency), build script, and four static pages: dashboard, test explorer, timeline, token usage.

Build ran 138 tests, all passing. Mutation check: injected 3 bugs (nulls counted as 'No', stale dashboard data, policy with empty evidence quote); tests caught each one (3, 1, 1 failures). Restored and rebuilt green. Rendered all 4 pages in the browser; no console errors.
Moved project to Documents/CS Special Topics/Project-2 and approved publishing it as a public GitHub repo with Pages.
Installed GitHub CLI; student signed in. Created public repo Shashank-Sathiya/genai-cs-course-policies, enabled GitHub Pages; CI ran 138 tests (all pass) and deployed the site.
Spot-checked rows 1-5 (CS50x, CS106A, CS106B, CS166, CS193X) against their source links; all matched. Results recorded in docs/VALIDATION.md.
Wrote the project evaluation (docs/EVALUATION.md), assessing which goals were met, partly met, or not met.

Set up /clear vs /compact token experiment: added scripts/checkpoint.py, checkpoint instructions in CLAUDE.md, experiment panel on tokens page. Recorded 'before /clear' checkpoint (182,173 context tokens).

After /clear (fresh session): 76,300 context tokens (system tools 37.3k, MCP tools 20.5k, system prompt 11.8k, skills 5.8k, memory 0.8k), down from 182,173 before /clear. After the reload task (reading specs/STATUS.md and summarizing): 76,311 tokens, as reported by get_usage. The meter only counted 11 message tokens, so it probably lags behind the turn in progress.

Re-took the after-reload reading on a new turn, intended to replace the 76,311 reading that lagged within its turn. get_usage reported 76,300 context tokens (5h 22%, weekly 5%) with no Messages category at all. That is the same as the after-/clear reading, so this meter appears to count only fixed overhead (tools, system prompt, skills, memory) in this session and does not reflect the reload's message tokens.
